source_text: In loco ubi offeruntur holocausta occident peccatum. Idem locus ignis — Christus et iudicium et propitiatio.
pass_a_gloss: In place where are-offered burnt-offerings they-will-kill sin-offering. Same place of-fire — Christ both judgment and propitiation.
pass_b_english: [[In the place where burnt offerings are killed they shall kill the sin offering >> Bible:Leviticus 6:25]]. One fire-place — Christ is both judgment and propitiation.
